verifiedBy: Claude (lane C engineer, Scope 3 completion I-12h), 2026-10-30; built by tools/method-reference/build_scope3_us_building_hotel_register.py from the committed transcription files
method: Register R6 for Scope 3 categories 6 (hotel stays) and 8, 13 and 14 (buildings by floor area). Hand transcriptions (DESIGN 13): each value was read twice with WebFetch from the official document and both quotes agree; the builder asserts agreement, that the printed value appears in both quotes and, for CBECS rows, the parsed per-square-foot column. EIA CBECS 2018 Table C14 (kWh per sq ft) and Table C24 (cubic feet of natural gas per sq ft) are conditional intensities (EIA guide: "If the table title does not specify, energy intensity should be interpreted as conditional energy intensity"; neither title specifies), so C24 averages only buildings that use natural gas. EPA, Greenhouse Gas Inventory Guidance: Indirect Emissions from Events and Conferences (December 2018), Table 5: kWh and MMBtu per available room-night by hotel class, from the EPA CHP Partnership report CHP in the Hotel and Casino Market Sectors (December 2005; the guidance cites it as December 2015) Table 16 x Table 17 / 365; the column order of Table 5 is resolved by repeating that arithmetic exactly (source.hotelColumnCheck): every printed value is reproduced within its printed rounding and the swapped order is not. The data are 2005-vintage and per available (not occupied) room-night. No value is derived or typed by hand.

source.publisher: U.S. Energy Information Administration (CBECS 2018); U.S. EPA Center for Corporate Climate Leadership (events guidance 2018); EPA CHP Partnership (2005)
source.title: 2018 CBECS Tables C14 and C24; Greenhouse Gas Inventory Guidance: Indirect Emissions from Events and Conferences, Table 5
source.edition: CBECS 2018 preliminary release September 2022, revised December 2022; events guidance December 2018; CHP hotel report December 2005; licence: U.S. Government works, public domain
source.sha256Of: the transcription file named in url (Neuvetra double-read transcriptions), not the EIA or EPA documents, which are not staged (see documents)
